definition{
  name: strMember,
  parameters: [value : String, values : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => ((prim equal value head : Bool) || (strMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: allStrMember,
  parameters: [wanted : (List String), values : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match wanted
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((strMember head values) && (allStrMember rest values))),
  recursive_argument: wanted
}

definition{
  name: noRepeats,
  parameters: [values : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => (if (strMember head rest) then false else (noRepeats rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

structure{
  name: PairKey,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: left, type: String}, {name: right, type: String}]
}

structure{
  name: TripleKey,
  type_parameters: [],
  parameters: [],
  fields: [{name: one, type: String}, {name: two, type: String}, {name: three, type: String}]
}

definition{
  name: key2,
  parameters: [left : String, right : String],
  result: PairKey,
  body: (record PairKey {left := left, right := right})
}

definition{
  name: key3,
  parameters: [one : String, two : String, three : String],
  result: TripleKey,
  body: (record TripleKey {one := one, two := two, three := three})
}

definition{
  name: pairMember,
  parameters: [value : PairKey, values : (List PairKey)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => (((prim equal (project value left) (project head left) : Bool) && (prim equal (project value right) (project head right) : Bool)) || (pairMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: pairsDistinct,
  parameters: [values : (List PairKey)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => (if (pairMember head rest) then false else (pairsDistinct rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: tripleMember,
  parameters: [value : TripleKey, values : (List TripleKey)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => (((prim equal (project value one) (project head one) : Bool) && ((prim equal (project value two) (project head two) : Bool) && (prim equal (project value three) (project head three) : Bool))) || (tripleMember value rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: triplesDistinct,
  parameters: [values : (List TripleKey)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match values
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => (if (tripleMember head rest) then false else (triplesDistinct rest))),
  recursive_argument: values
}

definition{
  name: differ,
  parameters: [left : String, right : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: (if (prim equal left right : Bool) then false else true)
}

definition{
  name: differNat,
  parameters: [left : Nat, right : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (if (left =? right) then false else true)
}

definition{
  name: idsOf,
  parameters: [entries : (List IdEntry)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => (nil String)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head id) (idsOf rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: entryIndexes,
  parameters: [entries : (List IdEntry)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head index) (entryIndexes rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: idAt,
  parameters: [wanted : Nat, entries : (List IdEntry)],
  result: String,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => ""
    | List.cons head rest => (if ((project head index) =? wanted) then (project head id) else (idAt wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: componentIds,
  parameters: [],
  result: (List String),
  body: (idsOf (componentTable))
}

definition{
  name: edgeFlows,
  parameters: [origin : String, dest : String, edges : (List Foundation.Arch::Edge)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match edges
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => (((prim equal (idAt (project head fromIndex) (componentTable)) origin : Bool) && (prim equal (idAt (project head toIndex) (componentTable)) dest : Bool)) || (edgeFlows origin dest rest))),
  recursive_argument: edges
}

definition{
  name: flows,
  parameters: [origin : String, dest : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: (edgeFlows origin dest (Architecture::edgeRecords))
}

definition{
  name: connected,
  parameters: [left : String, right : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((flows left right) || (flows right left))
}

definition{
  name: edgeEnds,
  parameters: [wanted : Nat, edges : (List Foundation.Arch::Edge), shown : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match edges
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => (if ((project head index) =? wanted) then ((strMember (idAt (project head fromIndex) (componentTable)) shown) && (strMember (idAt (project head toIndex) (componentTable)) shown)) else (edgeEnds wanted rest shown))),
  recursive_argument: edges
}

definition{
  name: edgeBound,
  parameters: [wanted : String, table : (List IdEntry), shown : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match table
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => (if (prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) then (edgeEnds (project head index) (Architecture::edgeRecords) shown) else (edgeBound wanted rest shown))),
  recursive_argument: table
}

definition{
  name: processIds,
  parameters: [entries : (List ProcessEntry)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => (nil String)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head id) (processIds rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: stateIds,
  parameters: [entries : (List StateEntry)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => (nil String)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head id) (stateIds rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: viewIds,
  parameters: [entries : (List ViewEntry)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => (nil String)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head id) (viewIds rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: processOwner,
  parameters: [wanted : String, entries : (List ProcessEntry)],
  result: String,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => ""
    | List.cons head rest => (if (prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) then (project (project head process) owner) else (processOwner wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: stateOwner,
  parameters: [wanted : String, entries : (List StateEntry)],
  result: String,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => ""
    | List.cons head rest => (if (prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) then (project (project head state) owner) else (stateOwner wanted rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: ownedProcesses,
  parameters: [entries : (List ProcessEntry)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((strMember (project (project head process) owner) (componentIds)) && (ownedProcesses rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: ownedStates,
  parameters: [entries : (List StateEntry)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((strMember (project (project head state) owner) (componentIds)) && (ownedStates rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: ownersKnown,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((ownedProcesses (processEntries)) && (ownedStates (stateEntries)))
}

definition{
  name: diagramCode,
  parameters: [diagram : Foundation.Arch::DesignDiagram],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match diagram
    | Foundation.Arch::DesignDiagram.opmObjectProcess => 0
    | Foundation.Arch::DesignDiagram.umlComponent => 1
    | Foundation.Arch::DesignDiagram.umlSequence => 2
    | Foundation.Arch::DesignDiagram.umlStateMachine => 3)
}

definition{
  name: viewOfKind,
  parameters: [wanted : String, code : Nat, entries : (List ViewEntry)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons head rest => (((prim equal wanted (project head id) : Bool) && ((diagramCode (project (project head view) diagram)) =? code)) || (viewOfKind wanted code rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: designViewsConform,
  parameters: [entries : (List ViewEntry)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match entries
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((strMember (project (project head view) viewpoint) (idsOf (viewpointTable))) && (designViewsConform rest))),
  recursive_argument: entries
}

definition{
  name: edgeRecordIndexes,
  parameters: [records : (List Foundation.Arch::Edge)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match records
    | List.nil => (nil Nat)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (project head index) (edgeRecordIndexes rest))),
  recursive_argument: records
}

definition{
  name: tablesAligned,
  parameters: [],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((Architecture::sameNats (entryIndexes (componentTable)) (Architecture::componentIndexes (Architecture::componentRecords))) && ((Architecture::sameNats (entryIndexes (edgeTable)) (edgeRecordIndexes (Architecture::edgeRecords))) && (Architecture::sameNats (entryIndexes (viewpointTable)) (Architecture::viewpointIndexes (Architecture::viewpointRecords)))))
}

definition{
  name: kindCode,
  parameters: [kind : Foundation.Arch::OpmThingKind],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match kind
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmThingKind.object => 1
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmThingKind.process => 2)
}

definition{
  name: thingCode,
  parameters: [view : String, name : String, things : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmThing)],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match things
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons head rest => (if ((prim equal view (project head view) : Bool) && (prim equal name (project head subject) : Bool)) then (kindCode (project head kind)) else (thingCode view name rest))),
  recursive_argument: things
}

definition{
  name: thingKeys,
  parameters: [things : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmThing)],
  result: (List PairKey),
  body: (match things
    | List.nil => (nil PairKey)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (key2 (project head view) (project head subject)) (thingKeys rest))),
  recursive_argument: things
}

definition{
  name: thingsResolve,
  parameters: [things : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmThing)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match things
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((viewOfKind (project head view) 0 (viewEntries)) && ((match (project head kind)
      | Foundation.Arch::OpmThingKind.object => (strMember (project head subject) (componentIds))
      | Foundation.Arch::OpmThingKind.process => (strMember (project head subject) (processIds (processEntries)))) && (thingsResolve rest)))),
  recursive_argument: things
}

definition{
  name: statesResolve,
  parameters: [states : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmState)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match states
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((viewOfKind (project head view) 0 (viewEntries)) && (((thingCode (project head view) (project head thing) (opmThings)) =? 1) && ((strMember (project head state) (stateIds (stateEntries))) && ((prim equal (stateOwner (project head state) (stateEntries)) (project head thing) : Bool) && (statesResolve rest)))))),
  recursive_argument: states
}

definition{
  name: stateKeys,
  parameters: [states : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmState)],
  result: (List TripleKey),
  body: (match states
    | List.nil => (nil TripleKey)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (key3 (project head view) (project head thing) (project head state)) (stateKeys rest))),
  recursive_argument: states
}

definition{
  name: linkShaped,
  parameters: [
    kind : Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind,
    source : String,
    target : String,
    left : Nat,
    right : Nat
  ],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match kind
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.agent => ((left =? 1) && (right =? 2))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.instrument => ((left =? 1) && (right =? 2))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.consumption => ((left =? 1) && (right =? 2))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.effect => ((left =? 1) && (right =? 2))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.result => ((left =? 2) && (right =? 1))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.invocation => ((left =? 2) && (right =? 2))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.aggregation => ((left =? right) && ((differNat left 0) && (differ source target)))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.exhibition => ((differNat left 0) && ((differNat right 0) && (differ source target)))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.generalization => ((left =? right) && ((differNat left 0) && (differ source target)))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.classification => ((left =? right) && ((differNat left 0) && (differ source target))))
}

definition{
  name: processBacked,
  parameters: [step : String, owner : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((prim equal (processOwner step (processEntries)) owner : Bool) || (connected owner (processOwner step (processEntries))))
}

definition{
  name: linkBacked,
  parameters: [kind : Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind, source : String, target : String, left : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match kind
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.agent => (if (left =? 1) then (processBacked target source) else (processBacked source target))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.instrument => (if (left =? 1) then (processBacked target source) else (processBacked source target))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.consumption => (if (left =? 1) then (processBacked target source) else (processBacked source target))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.effect => (if (left =? 1) then (processBacked target source) else (processBacked source target))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.result => (if (left =? 1) then (processBacked target source) else (processBacked source target))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.invocation => ((prim equal (processOwner source (processEntries)) (processOwner target (processEntries)) : Bool) || (flows (processOwner source (processEntries)) (processOwner target (processEntries))))
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.aggregation => true
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.exhibition => true
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.generalization => true
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.classification => true)
}

definition{
  name: linkKeyKind,
  parameters: [kind : Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind],
  result: String,
  body: (match kind
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.agent => "agent"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.instrument => "instrument"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.consumption => "consumption"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.effect => "effect"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.result => "result"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.invocation => "invocation"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.aggregation => "aggregation"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.exhibition => "exhibition"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.generalization => "generalization"
    | Foundation.Arch::OpmLinkKind.classification => "classification")
}

definition{
  name: linksResolve,
  parameters: [links : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmLink)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match links
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((viewOfKind (project head view) 0 (viewEntries)) && ((linkShaped (project head kind) (project head source) (project head target) (thingCode (project head view) (project head source) (opmThings)) (thingCode (project head view) (project head target) (opmThings))) && ((linkBacked (project head kind) (project head source) (project head target) (thingCode (project head view) (project head source) (opmThings))) && (linksResolve rest))))),
  recursive_argument: links
}

definition{
  name: linkKeys,
  parameters: [links : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmLink)],
  result: (List TripleKey),
  body: (match links
    | List.nil => (nil TripleKey)
    | List.cons head rest => (cons (key3 (linkKeyKind (project head kind)) (project head source) (project head target)) (linkKeys rest))),
  recursive_argument: links
}

definition{
  name: zoomsResolve,
  parameters: [zooms : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmZoom)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match zooms
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => ((viewOfKind (project head view) 0 (viewEntries)) && (((thingCode (project head view) (project head process) (opmThings)) =? 2) && (((thingCode (project head view) (project head subprocess) (opmThings)) =? 2) && ((differ (project head process) (project head subprocess)) && (zoomsResolve rest)))))),
  recursive_argument: zooms
}

definition{
  name: zoomClash,
  parameters: [head : Foundation.Arch::OpmZoom, rest : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmZoom)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match rest
    | List.nil => false
    | List.cons other more => ((((prim equal (project head view) (project other view) : Bool) && (prim equal (project head process) (project other process) : Bool)) && ((project head order) =? (project other order))) || (zoomClash head more))),
  recursive_argument: rest
}

definition{
  name: zoomPositionsFree,
  parameters: [zooms : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmZoom)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match zooms
    | List.nil => true
    | List.cons head rest => (if (zoomClash head rest) then false else (zoomPositionsFree rest))),
  recursive_argument: zooms
}

definition{
  name: zoomChildren,
  parameters: [zooms : (List Foundation.Arch::OpmZoom)],
  result: (List PairKey),
  body: (match zooms
